short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 八 and 玩.
short.answer: 八: bā, eight. 玩: wán, to play.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Who is this?"
short.answer: 这是谁? zhè shì shéi?
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write these position words in Chinese with pinyin: beside, above and below.
short.answer: 旁边 pángbiān, 上面 shàngmiàn, 下面 xiàmiàn.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write in Chinese and pinyin: "The wind is very strong."
short.answer: 风很大。 fēng hěn dà.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 明天 and 二.
short.answer: 明天: míngtiān, tomorrow. 二: èr, two.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 肩膀, 切 and 去.
short.answer: 肩膀: jiānbǎng, shoulder. 切: qiē, to cut. 去: qù, to go.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Happy birthday to you!" and "When is your birthday?"
short.answer: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè! 你生日是几月几号? nǐ shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào?
short.working: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

short.q: Explain what stress is in reading aloud and give an example.
short.answer: Stress means saying an important word a little stronger. For example in 我们切蛋糕, you may stress 蛋糕 to show what we cut. It does not change the tone.
short.working: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for an example, 1 mark for the tone note.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The bathroom is beside the garden."
short.answer: 浴室在花园旁边。 yùshì zài huāyuán pángbiān.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Write "Happy birthday to you" in characters and pinyin.
short.answer: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 水, 没有 and 门.
short.answer: 水: shuǐ, water. 没有: méiyǒu, there is not. 门: mén, door.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Draw the four tone marks over the vowel a and name each tone.
short.answer: ā first tone (high, flat), á second tone (rising), ǎ third tone (dipping), à fourth tone (falling).
short.working: 1 mark for two correct marks, 2 marks for three, 3 marks for all four with names.

short.q: What does it mean to listen for gist? Give one way to do it.
short.answer: Listening for gist means finding the main idea. You can listen for key words you already know.
short.working: 1 mark for meaning and 1 mark for a method.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 放 and 蜡烛.
short.answer: 放: fàng, to put. 蜡烛: làzhú, candle.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Explain what tone, volume and vocal projection mean when reading aloud.
short.answer: Tone is the rise and fall of each syllable, volume is how loud you speak and projection is sending your voice to the back of the room without shouting.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write the question for "Who is this?" and answer it with "This is my father", with pinyin.
short.answer: 这是谁? zhè shì shéi? 这是我爸爸。 zhè shì wǒ bàba.
short.working: 1 mark for the question and 1 mark for the answer.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Wednesday I go to school."
short.answer: 我星期三去学校。 wǒ xīngqīsān qù xuéxiào.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "For breakfast I eat bǐng."
short.answer: 我早饭吃饼。 wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 小 and 哥哥.
short.answer: 小: xiǎo, small. 哥哥: gēge, older brother.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Explain one way rain helps the environment and one way too much rain harms it.
short.answer: Rain gives water to crops, rivers and animals. Too much rain can cause floods that damage crops and homes.
short.working: 2 marks for the benefit and 2 marks for the harm.

short.q: Describe how to work out the meaning of an unknown word in a sentence.
short.answer: Read the whole sentence, look at the words you know, look at pictures, then guess and check with a friend or dictionary.
short.working: 1 mark for each of three steps.

short.q: Write a paragraph of four sentences about your week in Chinese with pinyin, using the days and activities from this lesson.
short.answer: 星期一到星期五,我去学校。星期六,我在家休息。星期天,我去教堂。 xīngqīyī dào xīngqīwǔ, wǒ qù xuéxiào. xīngqīliù, wǒ zài jiā xiūxi. xīngqītiān, wǒ qù jiàotáng.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for order and punctuation. Any sensible activities.

short.q: Write three birthday activities in Chinese or English.
short.answer: 切蛋糕 (cut the cake), 送礼物 (give gifts), 唱歌 (sing), 和朋友一起玩 (play with friends). Any three.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 水果 and 蔬菜.
short.answer: 水果: shuǐguǒ, fruit (as a group). 蔬菜: shūcài, vegetables.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: yǔ hěn dà.
short.answer: The rain is heavy.
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 肉, 用 and 摸.
short.answer: 肉: ròu, meat. 用: yòng, to use. 摸: mō, to touch.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Read and translate the chant line: 风来了,雨来了,雪也来了。
short.answer: Fēng lái le, yǔ lái le, xuě yě lái le. The wind has come, the rain has come, the snow has come too.
short.working: 1 mark for pinyin, 2 marks for meaning.

short.q: Read and translate: 冰箱在厨房。 Then write the question that asks where the fridge is.
short.answer: bīngxiāng zài chúfáng. The fridge is in the kitchen. Question: 冰箱在哪儿?
short.working: 1 mark for pinyin, 1 mark for translation, 1 mark for the question.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 刷牙, 手 and 生日.
short.answer: 刷牙: shuāyá, to brush teeth. 手: shǒu, hand. 生日: shēngrì, birthday.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 清真寺 and 一.
short.answer: 清真寺: qīngzhēnsì, mosque. 一: yī, one.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write a short conversation of three lines in which two learners greet each other, give their names and ask "And you?". Include pinyin.
short.answer: A: 你好! nǐ hǎo! B: 你好!我叫安娜。你呢? nǐ hǎo! wǒ jiào Ānnà. nǐ ne? A: 我叫小明。 wǒ jiào Xiǎomíng.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct greeting line and 1 mark each for the name sentences, 1 mark for correct pinyin tone marks, 5 in total.

short.q: Explain the sentence pattern for saying where something is, with an example.
short.answer: Thing + 在 + place, with 上 or 下 at the end when needed. For example 电视在桌子上。
short.working: 1 mark for the pattern, 1 mark for the example, 1 mark for the translation.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The sun is very big."
short.answer: 太阳很大。 tàiyáng hěn dà.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Arrange the words to make a sentence and translate: 礼物 / 送 / 朋友 / 我.
short.answer: 朋友送我礼物。 My friend gives me a gift.
short.working: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for the translation.

short.q: Rearrange and translate: 浴室 / 花园 / 旁边 / 在.
short.answer: 浴室在花园旁边。 The bathroom is beside the garden.
short.working: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for the meaning.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: chuānghu zài shāfā shàngmiàn.
short.answer: The window is above the sofa.
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 喜欢 and 哪儿.
short.answer: 喜欢: xǐhuan, to like. 哪儿: nǎr, where.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Today is Wednesday."
short.answer: 今天星期三。 jīntiān xīngqīsān.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Give two words with the final -ao and one with the final -ang, with pinyin.
short.answer: For example 好 hǎo, 小 xiǎo; 房 fáng.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I drink tea."
short.answer: 我喝茶。 wǒ hē chá.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Hello!" and "Hello! (polite)"
short.answer: 你好! nǐ hǎo! 您好! nín hǎo!
short.working: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

short.q: Put these pinyin words in alphabetical order: mǐfàn, bǐng, chá.
short.answer: bǐng, chá, mǐfàn.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct position.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The weather is very good today."
short.answer: 今天天气很好。 jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: zhè shì xiāngjiāo.
short.answer: This is a banana.
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Write a short dialogue of four lines in Chinese with pinyin: two friends greet each other and one says it is their birthday.
short.answer: A: 你好! nǐ hǎo! B: 你好! nǐ hǎo! A: 今天是我的生日。 jīntiān shì wǒ de shēngrì. B: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!
short.working: 1 mark for each correct line, with pinyin.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I like to drink tea."
short.answer: 我喜欢喝茶。 wǒ xǐhuan hē chá.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write in Chinese and pinyin: "Today it rains."
short.answer: 今天下雨。 jīntiān xià yǔ.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The garden is on the right of the house."
short.answer: 花园在房子右边。 huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Write the difference in meaning between chuáng and chuāng.
short.answer: chuáng 床 is a bed and chuāng 窗 is a window. The tones are different.
short.working: 1 mark for each meaning.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Where is the television?"
short.answer: 电视在哪儿? diànshì zài nǎr?
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my mouth to speak."
short.answer: 我用嘴巴说。 wǒ yòng zuǐba shuō.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Give one challenge of writing Chinese and one way to overcome it.
short.answer: For example, remembering stroke order; practise a few characters each day and use flashcards.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Hello, teacher!"
short.answer: 老师好! lǎoshī hǎo!
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Give two habits for keeping your body clean.
short.answer: Wash your hands with soap (洗手), brush your teeth (刷牙), bathe often, wear clean clothes.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write the five weather words in pinyin.
short.answer: tàiyáng, yún, fēng, yǔ, xuě.
short.working: 1 mark for two, 2 marks for four, 3 marks for all five.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 客厅 and 咖啡.
short.answer: 客厅: kètīng, living room. 咖啡: kāfēi, coffee.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Give three ways to make a reading club work well.
short.answer: Be kind and do not laugh at mistakes, listen while others read, take turns fairly and help others who find reading hard.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: míngtiān shì xīngqīsì.
short.answer: Tomorrow is Thursday.
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 九 and 号.
short.answer: 九: jiǔ, nine. 号: hào, date (day of the month).
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "We sing."
short.answer: 我们唱歌。 wǒmen chànggē.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 祝 and 电视.
short.answer: 祝: zhù, to wish. 电视: diànshì, television.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 风 and 鸡肉.
short.answer: 风: fēng, wind. 鸡肉: jīròu, chicken (meat).
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write the Chinese for "I laugh" and "I cry" with pinyin.
short.answer: 我笑 wǒ xiào; 我哭 wǒ kū.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Explain how to pause when reading: what does a comma mean and what does a full stop mean?
short.answer: A comma is a short pause and a full stop is a longer pause, so you can breathe and the listener can follow.
short.working: 1 mark for comma, 1 mark for full stop, 1 mark for the reason.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 盘子, 爱 and 唱歌.
short.answer: 盘子: pánzi, plate. 爱: ài, love. 唱歌: chànggē, to sing.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Give three things to do when planning a showcase item.
short.answer: Choose an item, decide who does what, list the materials and words needed, practise several times.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "What is this?" and "This is a banana."
short.answer: 这是什么? zhè shì shénme? 这是香蕉。 zhè shì xiāngjiāo.
short.working: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "That is my younger brother."
short.answer: 那是我弟弟。 nà shì wǒ dìdi.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "We cut the cake."
short.answer: 我们切蛋糕。 wǒmen qiē dàngāo.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: nǐ ne?
short.answer: And you?
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Answer the riddle in Chinese with pinyin: "I help you hear. I am on the sides of your head."
short.answer: 耳朵 ěrduo (ears).
short.working: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the pinyin.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I love you."
short.answer: 我爱你。 wǒ ài nǐ.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Today there are clouds."
short.answer: 今天有云。 jīntiān yǒu yún.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write the Chinese words for head, hand and foot, with pinyin.
short.answer: 头 tóu, 手 shǒu, 脚 jiǎo.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write the stroke order of 大 in Chinese stroke names.
short.answer: 横, 撇, 捺.
short.working: 2 marks for all three in order, 1 mark for two.

short.q: Give the Chinese for mosque and church with pinyin.
short.answer: 清真寺 qīngzhēnsì and 教堂 jiàotáng.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 旁边 and 您好.
short.answer: 旁边: pángbiān, beside. 您好: nín hǎo, hello (polite).
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: State three rules of stroke order and give an example of each.
short.answer: Top to bottom (三), left to right (好: 女 then 子), horizontal before vertical (十), 撇 before 捺 (人).
short.working: 1 mark for each rule with an example.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The wind is very light."
short.answer: 风很小。 fēng hěn xiǎo.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The sofa is beside the door." and "The bathroom is beside the garden."
short.answer: 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān. 浴室在花园旁边。 yùshì zài huāyuán pángbiān.
short.working: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ xīngqīsān qù xuéxiào.
short.answer: On Wednesday I go to school.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 香蕉 and 饼.
short.answer: 香蕉: xiāngjiāo, banana. 饼: bǐng, flat bread.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Describe how to say the initials b and p differently, and give one more pair like them.
short.answer: b is said without a puff of air and p with a puff of air. Another pair is d and t (or g and k). You can test with a paper strip, which moves more with p.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 上面, 周 and 同学们.

short.answer: 礼物: lǐwù, gift. 冰箱: bīngxiāng, fridge.

short.answer: 听: tīng, to listen, to hear. 雨: yǔ, rain.

short.answer: We cut the cake.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Hello! (polite)"
short.answer: 您好! nín hǎo!

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The television is in the living room."
short.answer: 电视在客厅。 diànshì zài kètīng.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write a five-sentence description of your family in Chinese with pinyin, using 这是 and 我家有.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Hello!"
short.answer: 你好! nǐ hǎo!

short.answer: 再见! zàijiàn!

short.q: Explain why tones are important in Mandarin. Give one example with meanings.
short.answer: The tone changes the meaning of a word. For example mā means mother but mǎ means horse.

short.q: Write the stroke names of 手 in order.
short.answer: 撇, 横, 横, 竖钩.

short.q: Give three tips for following spoken instructions well.
short.answer: Listen to the whole instruction; catch the key words; ask for a repeat if unsure; show the answer by pointing or drawing.

short.answer: 你好! 我叫小明。 你呢?
